$comment: Configuration for the golden-vector trace. All time values are in MICROSECONDS. Derived constants are included so tests can assert them independently of the acquisition trace; they follow from the formulas in the spec and should be re-derived, not trusted.

provenance.note: Expected values in golden-vectors.csv are produced by hand-derivation and confirmed against the Guava reference implementation driven by a fake stopwatch.

initialState.$comment: SmoothWarmingUp starts fully cold: the pot begins at maxPermits.

tolerance.$comment: Floating-point comparison epsilon. Absolute, in microseconds for time values and in permits for permit values.
